name: Captain Media Shield
author: Devang Vachheta

sections.description:
Captain Media Shield is a comprehensive, on-server media optimization and storage reclaim suite for WordPress. Automatically convert images to lightweight Next Generation WebP and AVIF formats, compress video uploads with instant streaming (FastStart), and reclaim disk space by safely finding and removing unused media, byte-for-byte duplicate files, and leftover thumbnails.

Everything runs 100% on your own hosting server – no external APIs, no image credits, no third-party accounts, and zero monthly subscriptions.

Official Plugin Page | YouTube Tutorials | Free Support

🛡️ Why Choose Captain Media Shield?

  • 100% Free & Unlimited : No third-party API dependencies, no monthly quotas, and no subscription paywalls. Optimize thousands of images and videos without worrying about limits.
  • Next Generation WebP & AVIF Formats : Generate ultra-compact WebP and AVIF copies for original images and every registered thumbnail size.
  • Live Page Media Inspector (Admin Bar) : Real-time media analysis from your front-end top toolbar with instant highlight on page and 1-click batch optimization.
  • In-Browser Upload Rescue Assistant : Automatically downscales oversized images directly in the browser when they exceed hosting upload limits.
  • Server Limit Booster Guide : Interactive helper with ready directives for Apache, .htaccess, and php.ini to boost upload and execution limits.
  • Per-Image Custom Quality Override : Set global compression quality (1-100) or override quality for any individual image directly from the Media Library list view via the Quick Quality modal.
  • Media Cleanup & Storage Saver : Safely detect and clean orphaned media, byte-for-byte MD5 duplicate files, and leftover legacy thumbnails from retired themes.
  • Storage Diagnostics & Report : Visual breakdown of your entire uploads directory by file category, file extension, upload year, and largest files.
  • Video Compression & Streaming : H.264 FastStart streaming, WebM companions, automatic poster frames, and animated GIF to video conversion.
  • Safe Backups & 1-Click Restore : Untouched original files are preserved with configurable retention periods and 1-click restore.
  • Modern Tabbed Navigation : Fast, organized tabbed settings interface that eliminates long vertical scrolling.
  • Top Header Quick Actions : Convenient Save Changes and Reset to Defaults buttons placed right in the header for quick access.
  • WP-CLI Automation : Complete headless command-line interface for enterprise sites and automated background workflows.

📸 Next Generation Image Optimization & Delivery

  • Automated Next Generation Conversion : Converts JPEG and PNG uploads to high-efficiency WebP and AVIF copies.
  • Compression Quality Slider : Choose your default quality sweet spot (1-100) with recommended presets (Balanced, Aggressive, High Quality).
  • Media Library Quick Quality Modal : Click “Quick Quality” on any list-view item to adjust quality (e.g. 40-50% for heavy graphics) and re-optimize instantly.
  • Privacy & EXIF Metadata Removal : Strips camera EXIF data, GPS coordinates, IPTC, and editing history while preserving colour profiles.
  • Auto-Resize Large Uploads : Automatically scales down oversized camera images (e.g. 4000px+) before thumbnails are generated.
  • Flexible Delivery Methods : Serve Next Generation formats via high-speed .htaccess rewrite rules (Apache/LiteSpeed) or HTML <picture> tag replacement.
  • Nginx Configuration Generator : Ready-to-copy server configuration snippet for seamless Next Generation delivery on Nginx servers.
  • Smart Exclude Rules : Exclude folders (e.g. logos/*), filename patterns, or specific attachment IDs from optimization.

🎬 Video Optimization & Streaming (FFmpeg)

  • H.264 Video Compression : Re-encodes uploaded MP4/MOV videos to space-saving H.264 in place.
  • Moov Atom “Fast Start” : Relocates video metadata to the beginning of the file so visitors can stream videos immediately without waiting for full download.
  • WebM Companion Files : Automatically generates modern VP9/Opus WebM copies for HTML5 video players and the WordPress video block.
  • Automatic Video Poster Frames : Saves a lightweight JPEG frame next to each video for an instant preview instead of a black box.
  • Animated GIF to Video Conversion : Converts heavy animated GIFs into lightweight looping MP4/WebM videos (80-95% file size reduction).
  • Resolution & Bitrate Controls : Cap video resolution (1080p, 720p, Keep Original) and adjust audio compression (128 kbps, 96 kbps).
  • Background WP-Cron Processing : Video encoding runs asynchronously in the background so dashboard uploads stay quick and responsive.

🧹 Deep Media Cleanup & Duplicate Detector

  • Unused Media Finder : Deep scans post content, Gutenberg blocks, featured images, WooCommerce galleries, widgets, custom post types, and custom fields. Anything potentially in use is protected.
  • Byte-for-Byte Duplicate Detector : Compares files by exact size and MD5 hash fingerprint. Duplicates in use are safely locked from deletion.
  • Orphan Thumbnail Cleaner : Scans and removes old thumbnail sizes registered by retired themes or uninstalled plugins.
  • Zero-Risk Confirmation : Nothing is ever deleted automatically. Deletions require explicit confirmation, and safety backup copies can be retained.
  • Interactive Storage Report : View storage distribution across original files, thumbnails, Next Generation copies, and backups.

💾 Backups & Safe Rollback

  • Zero-Risk Backups : Untouched original files are stored in wp-content/uploads/captain-ms-backups/.
  • Configurable Retention : Set how long backups are kept: immediately delete, 1 hour, 1 day, 7 days, 30 days, or indefinitely.
  • 1-Click Original Restore : Restore any original image or video directly from the Media Library list view or attachment details.
  • Disk Purge : “Purge All Backups Now” button lets you free up backup storage once you are completely satisfied with results.

⚡ WordPress Media Library Integration

  • Media Shield Status Column : Displays live optimization status (Optimized, Not Optimized, Processing), percentage saved, and active format badge (WebP/AVIF).
  • Inline Quick Actions : Re-optimize, adjust quality via Quick Quality popup, or restore originals with one click without leaving the page.

Perfect for:

  • Content Creators & Bloggers who want lightning-fast page loading and better Google Core Web Vitals (LCP).
  • WooCommerce Store Owners who need thousands of product images compressed without losing visual sharpness.
  • Photographers & Portfolio Sites wanting custom per-image compression quality for sensitive portfolio showcases.
  • Agencies & Developers managing client websites with strict disk space limits and hosting storage quotas.
  • High-Traffic Media Publishers looking to cut bandwidth costs with WebP/AVIF and FastStart video streaming.

Key Features

  • 🖼️ WebP & AVIF Conversion : Automated Next Generation image format generation for smaller, faster pages
  • 🎚️ Per-Image Quality Override : Set custom compression levels per image via Quick Quality popup or global slider
  • 🧹 Deep Media Cleanup : Find and safely remove orphaned media, duplicate files, and obsolete thumbnails
  • 📊 Storage Report & Analytics : Detailed visual breakdown of uploads by type, year, and largest files
  • 🎥 Video Compression & Streaming : H.264 FastStart streaming, WebM companion generation, and resolution capping
  • 🖼️ Video Poster Frames : Instant video thumbnail generation for player previews
  • 🎞️ Animated GIF to Video : 80-95% lighter looping MP4/WebM conversion for animated GIFs
  • 🛡️ Safe Backups & 1-Click Restore : Zero-loss original file preservation with flexible retention
  • 🌐 Multiple Delivery Methods : Support for Apache/LiteSpeed .htaccess, HTML <picture>, and Nginx rules
  • 🚫 Smart Exclude Rules : Skip folders, filename wildcards, or specific attachment IDs
  • 📑 Organized Tabbed Navigation : Clean tabbed settings interface that eliminates vertical scrolling
  • 🔝 Header Save & Reset Actions : Top-right header actions giving maximum vertical room for content
  • 🖥️ WP-CLI Integration : Full command-line support for automated workflows and large libraries
  • 🩺 Server Health Screen : Real-time diagnostic check for GD, Imagick, WebP, AVIF, and FFmpeg
  • 🌐 Multisite Compatible : Network activation and subsite management support
  • 🔒 100% Privacy Focused : Local server processing with no telemetry, external calls, or tracking

Supported Formats

  • Input Image Formats : JPEG, JPG, PNG, GIF
  • Output Next Generation Image Formats : WebP, AVIF
  • Input Video Formats : MP4, MOV, M4V, AVI, MKV, WMV (requires FFmpeg)
  • Output Video Formats : H.264 MP4 (FastStart streamable), WebM (VP9 / Opus)

YouTube Tutorials

  • Captain Media Shield – Full Plugin Overview & Tutorial : Complete video walkthrough covering Next Generation WebP/AVIF setup, Media Library Quick Quality, Video compression with FastStart streaming, and Deep Media Cleanup.
  • Captain InfoKit – Official YouTube Channel : Subscribe to our official YouTube channel for step-by-step video tutorials, media optimization walkthroughs, performance tips, and WordPress server setup guides.

🌟 OUR PRODUCTS

🥇 Captain Feed for YouTube : Display customizable YouTube feeds for channels, playlists, Shorts, search results, and individual videos.

🥇 Captain Advance Filter : Create powerful filters for WordPress with advanced filtering options, flexible layouts, and easy customization.

🥇 Captain Social Review : Display reviews and testimonials from multiple platforms with beautiful layouts, filtering options, and easy customization.

🥇 Captain Widgets Kit : Extend your WordPress website with a collection of powerful widgets and elements designed to enhance your website building experience.

🥇 Captain Funnel : Automate WhatsApp messages for WooCommerce orders and form submissions using the official WhatsApp Cloud API by Meta.

🥇 Captain Live Chat : Self-hosted live chat for WordPress with an AI agent, canned replies and full conversation history – no monthly subscription.

WP-CLI Commands

Manage image optimization and disk cleanup directly from your terminal:

  • wp capms optimize : Optimizes unoptimized media in your library.
  • wp capms optimize --type=image : Optimizes only image files.
  • wp capms optimize --type=video : Optimizes only video files.
  • wp capms optimize --retry-failed : Retries any previously failed or skipped files.
  • wp capms optimize --ids=101,102,103 : Optimizes specific media attachments.
  • wp capms restore <id>... : Restores original files for specified attachment IDs.
  • wp capms status : Displays summary of optimized media, storage savings, and format breakdown.
  • wp capms cleanup unused : Finds and removes media not used across posts, pages, or WooCommerce.
  • wp capms cleanup duplicates : Finds and cleans byte-for-byte identical files.
  • wp capms cleanup thumbs : Removes unregistered and obsolete thumbnail files.
  • wp capms purge_backups : Deletes all original backups to permanently reclaim disk space.

Privacy & Security

  • 100% On-Server Processing : All compression and conversion tasks run entirely on your local server. No image, video, metadata, or telemetry data is ever sent to external third parties.
  • EXIF & GPS Stripping : Removes sensitive location data, device models, and camera profiles before saving or serving images.
  • Protected Backups : Backups are stored in a dedicated directory protected by Apache .htaccess and Nginx server denial directives to prevent direct public access.

Usage Guide

  1. Configure Image Settings : Go to Images & Formats and select your preferred compression quality (75-80% is recommended). Enable WebP and AVIF.
  2. Choose Delivery Method : Select .htaccess Rewrites (fastest for Apache/LiteSpeed) or <picture> tag replacement (works on all servers).
  3. Run Bulk Optimizer : If you have existing uploads, navigate to Bulk Optimizer and click “Start Optimization”. The progress bar will update in real time.
  4. Manage Single Images : In Media -> Library (list view), use the “Quick Quality” button in the Media Shield column to override quality for any image.
  5. Reclaim Disk Space : Go to Media Cleanup to scan for unused files, duplicates, and old thumbnail sizes, then safely delete what you don’t need.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/captain-media-shield directory, or install directly through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin from the Plugins screen.
  3. Go to Media -> Captain Media Shield -> Server Health to verify your server environment (GD/Imagick WebP/AVIF support and FFmpeg).
  4. Open Images & Formats to configure your desired format settings, compression quality, and delivery method.
  5. Open Bulk Optimizer to compress your existing Media Library in batch, or let new uploads optimize automatically.
sections.faq:
Can I set different compression quality for specific images?

Yes! While the global compression quality slider sets the default quality for all uploads (recommended: 75-80%), you can override quality for any individual image directly in the Media Library list view via the Quick Quality modal or in the attachment edit screen. You can set aggressive compression (e.g. 40-50%) for heavy banner graphics or high quality (90-95%) for sensitive photography.

I converted my images but I cannot find any .webp files. Where are they?

Converted files are saved directly in your uploads directory alongside the original files with the new extension appended, for example photo.jpg.webp and photo.jpg.avif. The WordPress Media Library continues to reference the original filename while modern browsers automatically receive the Next Generation format.

Why do I not get any AVIF files?

AVIF generation requires PHP GD with AVIF support (PHP 8.1+) or ImageMagick 7+ with AVIF delegates compiled. Check the Server Health tab in Captain Media Shield to see your server’s status. AVIF copies are also automatically discarded if they do not result in a smaller file size than the WebP version.

What happens if I enable both WebP and AVIF?

Both Next Generation copies are generated. Visitors with AVIF-compatible browsers receive the ultra-compact AVIF file, other modern browsers receive WebP, and older legacy browsers fall back to the original JPG/PNG.

My WooCommerce or Elementor images still load as JPG.

The Picture tag method filters standard WordPress post content and featured images. To serve Next Generation formats across all theme elements, sliders, Elementor widgets, and WooCommerce store templates, select the .htaccess Rewrites delivery method in Images & Formats -> Delivery & Server.

Does the .htaccess method work on Nginx?

Nginx does not read .htaccess files. However, Captain Media Shield includes a built-in Nginx Rules generator in Images & Formats -> Delivery & Server. Simply copy the snippet into your Nginx server configuration block and reload Nginx, or use the HTML <picture> tag method which works on all web servers.

How does Media Cleanup decide that a file is unused?

The scanner searches post and page content, Gutenberg blocks, featured images, WooCommerce gallery arrays, widgets, site icons/logos, custom taxonomies, and custom post meta. If any reference exists, the file is tagged as in use. Third-party plugins can register custom usage checks using the capms_attachment_usage_reasons filter.

Is it safe to delete duplicate files?

Yes. Only copies that are confirmed to have zero active usages can be deleted. If a duplicate is currently referenced in published content, the system marks it as “In Use” and prevents deletion until you replace the reference.

Do I need FFmpeg installed?

FFmpeg is only required for video compression (H.264), WebM generation, automatic video poster frames, and animated GIF to video conversion. All image optimization, WebP/AVIF generation, and Media Cleanup features function completely without FFmpeg.

Can I restore my original files?

Yes! As long as backups are enabled and within your configured retention window, you can restore original files with one click using the Restore Original button in the Media Library list view or Bulk Optimizer.

Will optimizing images affect my SEO ranking?

Yes, in a positive way! By serving WebP/AVIF and compressing large images, your page loading speed and Google Core Web Vitals (specifically Largest Contentful Paint – LCP) improve significantly, which is a confirmed ranking factor.

What happens when I deactivate or uninstall the plugin?

Upon deactivation or uninstallation, the plugin cleans up its database tables and scheduled events. Your original media files, converted Next Generation copies, and backups remain completely untouched on your server unless you choose to purge them.

How does the Admin Bar Page Media Inspector work?

When logged in as an administrator, the Page Media Inspector appears in your WordPress top toolbar on front-end pages. It scans all image elements rendered on the page, categorizing them into Next Generation (WebP/AVIF) and Original (JPG/PNG). You can click “Highlight on Page” to visually locate unoptimized images, or click “Optimize Page Images” to optimize all detected media in one click.

How does the Media Upload Rescue Assistant work?

If your web hosting imposes a low upload limit (e.g. 2 MB or 8 MB) and you attempt to upload a large camera photo (e.g. 15 MB), the built-in Rescue Assistant automatically steps in right inside your browser. It uses modern HTML5 canvas technology to downscale the image to web dimensions before sending it to WordPress, preventing frustrating HTTP 413 or 500 server errors.

Does Captain Media Shield send any data or images to external servers?

No. Never. Captain Media Shield operates 100% independently on your own web server using native PHP extensions (GD / Imagick) and local FFmpeg. Your media files, database records, and site information never leave your hosting server.

1.0.3 (07/11/2026)

  • Fix: Plugin Uninstallation : Resolved “Deletion failed:” error when deleting the plugin from WordPress admin by ensuring uninstall.php safely yields execution control back to WordPress filesystem cleanup.
  • Fix: Video HDR Tone-Mapping & Stream Mapping : Added Hable tone-mapping for HDR/HEVC video conversion to standard 8-bit BT.709 SDR to prevent washed-out colors. Preserved stream rotation/display matrix metadata via -map_metadata:g -1 and dropped extra foreign/commentary audio tracks.
  • Fix: First-Generation WebM Encoding : Reversed video companion pipeline order so WebM is encoded directly from the original source file, completely eliminating double-lossy recompression.
  • Fix: Quick Quality Modal Live Row Synchronization : Ensured all row action links across the Media Library list view immediately update their data attributes and quality indicators after saving in the Quick Quality modal.
  • Fix: Admin Page Notice Isolation : Suppressed third-party plugin notices (Elementor, WooCommerce, update nags) on Captain Media Shield admin screen to ensure a clean, uncluttered interface.
  • Fix: Privacy & GPS Metadata in Backups : Automatically strip camera EXIF/GPS coordinate metadata from original backup files when metadata stripping is enabled.
  • Fix: Re-compression Degradation Guard : Safeguard already compressed original images from generational quality degradation if re-optimized after backup purge.
  • Fix: Async Video Processing : Transition video optimization from synchronous AJAX requests to WP-Cron background queue to avoid gateway timeouts on large media.
  • Fix: Extended Picture Tag Delivery : Integrated responsive delivery filters for WooCommerce product/cart thumbnails, Full Site Editing block themes, and REST API rendered content.
  • Fix: Safety Copies for Intermediate Sub-sizes : Ensure intermediate thumbnail sizes are preserved alongside the original image in the deleted safety archive.
  • Fix: Unused Thumbnail Cleanup Safety : Added one-click safety backup toggle and automatic pre-selection on unused thumbnail scans.
  • Fix: Admin Bar Rewrite Detection : Accurate detection of Apache/Nginx URL rewrite delivery in the Admin Bar inspector to avoid false “Needs Optimization” indicators.
  • Improve: Admin Bar Real Dark Mode & Accessibility : Added real dark mode theme styling, @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce), and 480px mobile breakpoint to admin-bar.css.
  • Improve: Video Tutorials UI : Added a dedicated 4-card compact video tutorial section to the Help page and a quick “Watch Tutorial” link button in the Analytics & Server Health header.
  • Improve: Full POT Internationalization : Complete language template regeneration with 640+ translation keys.

1.0.2 (06/11/2026)

  • New: Animated GIF to MP4/WebM Conversion : Seamlessly convert bulky animated GIFs into lightweight MP4 and WebM video loops, saving up to 90% disk space while keeping animation smooth.
  • New: Media Limit Bypass : Automatically resizes oversized image uploads (exceeding limits like 2 MB) directly in-browser for seamless WordPress uploads.
  • New: Server Limit Booster Guide : Interactive popup modal with quick Apache/htaccess and php.ini directives to boost upload limit, including WAMP/local server quick steps.

WP-CLI Commands

Manage image optimization and disk cleanup directly from your terminal:

  • wp capms optimize : Optimizes unoptimized media in your library.
  • wp capms optimize --type=image : Optimizes only image files.
  • wp capms optimize --type=video : Optimizes only video files.
  • wp capms optimize --retry-failed : Retries any previously failed or skipped files.
  • wp capms optimize --ids=101,102,103 : Optimizes specific media attachments.
  • wp capms restore <id>... : Restores original files for specified attachment IDs.
  • wp capms status : Displays summary of optimized media, storage savings, and format breakdown.
  • wp capms cleanup unused : Finds and removes media not used across posts, pages, or WooCommerce.
  • wp capms cleanup duplicates : Finds and cleans byte-for-byte identical files.
  • wp capms cleanup thumbs : Removes unregistered and obsolete thumbnail files.
  • wp capms purge_backups : Deletes all original backups to permanently reclaim disk space.

Privacy & Security

  • 100% On-Server Processing : All compression and conversion tasks run entirely on your local server. No image, video, metadata, or telemetry data is ever sent to external third parties.
  • EXIF & GPS Stripping : Removes sensitive location data, device models, and camera profiles before saving or serving images.
  • Protected Backups : Backups are stored in a dedicated directory protected by Apache .htaccess and Nginx server denial directives to prevent direct public access.

Usage Guide

  1. Configure Image Settings : Go to Images & Formats and select your preferred compression quality (75-80% is recommended). Enable WebP and AVIF.
  2. Choose Delivery Method : Select .htaccess Rewrites (fastest for Apache/LiteSpeed) or <picture> tag replacement (works on all servers).
  3. Run Bulk Optimizer : If you have existing uploads, navigate to Bulk Optimizer and click “Start Optimization”. The progress bar will update in real time.
  4. Manage Single Images : In Media -> Library (list view), use the “Quick Quality” button in the Media Shield column to override quality for any image.
  5. Reclaim Disk Space : Go to Media Cleanup to scan for unused files, duplicates, and old thumbnail sizes, then safely delete what you don’t need.
